name: Forliarlo
backstory: Child of Forliamus and Farlo; grew up around unloads crates at the market stalls through the... in Terfila, and knows something of Temple Of The Crossing.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Trezco, named Forliazco.
Heard that Forliazco and Farlo now have a child, Farliazco.
Heard that Forliazco and Farmuken now have a child, Forliamuk.
Had a child with Forliuken, named Forliukar.
Heard that Farlo and Trezco now have a child, Trezarlo.
Had a child with Tamuzco, named Forliauzco.
Heard that Farliazco and Forliukar now have a child, Farliukar.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether Salthos Mediator Line is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what Salthos Mediator Line actually meant, the way most people already have
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes over more of the house's morning bookkeeping at the stalls, testing his own hand at pressing suppliers for better terms, and repeating the family's account of the dispute a little more confidently each time.

arc.premise: Forliarlo wants to know whether the Salthos house was truly chosen to mediate the crossing dispute or simply never left once it arrived - he means to find someone old enough to have seen the actual choosing, before that generation is gone.
